floor_history.headline: Gap is 100% frame-layout, not codegen: 139/139 insns identical, only the 9 reload spill slots sit at sp+4 mod 8 vs target's +0 — traced to cc1's big-endian bigend_correction on 8-rounded spill slots;
Structural axis measured dead across 11 variants; session 1's func_8006BD28 existence proof was authorized canonical asm, and a tree-wide census plus a cc1psx counter-exhibit show the +4 spill offset

Structural axis closed end to end: alter_reg's slot-REUSE branch — the one opening s2's proof left — is measured dead across 23 new C variants AND arithmetically incapable of producing target's nine 0

frontier.hypothesis: The reuse path at reload1.c:2363 may never be taken anywhere in Bushido Blade 2, which would close the congruence class by measurement as well as by proof.
frontier.mechanism: s3 measured 23 synthetic shapes for func_80060E38 and the path never fired, and showed why (SImode and 8-byte-mode pseudos never co-allocate to a commandeered hard register). The tree-wide question is still open and is the natural forensics target.
frontier.next_probe: Forensics modality: use the instrumented cc1 at tools/gcc-2.7.2/cc1 (NOT build/cc1 — see [[instrumented-cc1-location]]) to log every alter_reg call with (pseudo, from_reg, mode, total_size, chosen path, final offset) while compiling the real src/*.c translation units, and count how often the 2363 REUSE path is taken and with what modes. Scope it to the TREE, not to func_80060E38 (s3 already answered that), and instrument small TUs first — never recompile src/text1b.c whole.

frontier.hypothesis: assign_stack_temp-created slots (compiler temporaries for aggregate/structure copies) take neither the align == -1 spill path nor the plain declared-local path, so they may carry no big-endian correction while still being 8-byte-strided.
frontier.mechanism: The +4 is exclusive to assign_stack_local's align == -1 path (8-byte rounding => bigend_correction 4). v_locals.c (s2) measured that declared locals give stride 4, not target's stride 8, so ordinary locals are dead; assign_stack_temp is the last untried slot-creation route in function.c.
frontier.next_probe: Rederive modality: express the 32 constants as an aggregate initialisation or a memcpy-shaped construct and read the emitted slot stride from tmp/grind/func_80060E38/s1/run.sh's cc1 -da output. Expect the instruction count to move away from 139 — measure with sandbox --disable all before believing anything.

frontier.hypothesis: func_80060E38 is a member of a 29-function class defined by 'target contains a stride-8 reload-spill block', all blocked by the same measured fork property, and should be dispositioned as a class rather than ground one function at a time.
frontier.mechanism: Census (s2/spillscan2.txt): 29 stride-8 spill blocks tree-wide, all at 0 mod 8, all rule-carrying, none ever matched; the offset is === -GET_MODE_SIZE(mode) (mod 8) under our BYTES_BIG_ENDIAN cc1, and cc1psx fed identical input produces target's congruence. Every surface that could change it (the cc1 binary/configuration, the Makefile, prologue_config.json, regfix/asmfix) is outside the grind edit surface, and [[no-compiler-divergence]] forbids the compiler-side fix. s3 closed the last mechanism-level opening (the reuse branch).
frontier.next_probe: This remains an owner-surface question and the driver has NOT declared exhaustion, so it must not be escalated yet. Whichever session is assigned escalation modality should file the CLASS (not just func_80060E38) in docs/grind/decisions.md citing s2/spillscan2.txt, the closed-form proof, the cc1psx counter-exhibit and the s3 reuse-branch kill — and must NOT cite Ruling-2, whose scope limit explicitly excludes non-crashing fork divergences.
